en.metaDescription: Cannon Quest: load operations into the cannon, fire, and free x!
en.rotateHint:
Turn your device sideways
for the best view
en.tutTapOp: Tap an operation to load the cannon.
en.tutTapFireOne: Tap Fire to launch your operation.
en.tutOrder: Load the operations into the cannon in the order you want to apply them.
en.tutLeftRight: The cannon fires from left to right.
en.tutTapFireMany: Tap Fire to launch your operations.
en.voNext2: New equation! Can you free x?
en.voStuck1: Oh no! x is still stuck.
en.voStuck2: Not this time. x is still locked in!
en.voEndAll: Amazing! You freed x every single time!
en.voEndMost: Great job! You freed most of them!
en.voEndSome: Good try! Play again to free them all!
